description.zh: 专属块存储集群所属可用区ID。您可以调用[DescribeZones](~~25610~~)获取可用区列表。
description.en: The zone ID of the dedicated block storage cluster. You can call [DescribeZones](~~25610~~) to query the zone list.

description.zh:
专属块存储集群的容量。取值范围为61440~2334720GiB（2280 TiB），最小递增步长为12288 GiB。

> 当专属块存储集群的容量小于576 TiB时，每TiB支持的最大吞吐量性能不超过52 MB/s。当专属块存储集群的容量大于576 TiB时，每TiB支持的最大吞吐量性能不超过26 MB/s。
description.en:
The capacity of the dedicated block storage cluster. Valid values: 61440 to 2334720 GiB (2280 TiB). Minimum increment: 12288 GiB.

> When the capacity of the dedicated block storage cluster is less than 576 TiB, the maximum throughput per TiB does not exceed 52 MB/s. When the capacity of the dedicated block storage cluster is greater than 576 TiB, the maximum throughput per TiB does not exceed 26 MB/s.
The name of the dedicated block storage cluster.
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values: 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 24, and 36.

description.zh: 包年包月时长的时间单位，即参数`Period`的单位，目前仅支持Month。
description.en: The unit of the subscription duration specified by the `Period` parameter. Only Month is supported.

description.zh: 专属块存储集群所属地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the dedicated block storage cluster. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 专属块存储集群所在的企业资源组ID。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the dedicated block storage cluster belongs.

description.zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项。
description.en: The list of tags. A maximum of 20 tags can be specified.

description.zh: 专属块存储集群的标签键。
description.en: The tag key of the dedicated block storage cluster.

description.zh: 专属块存储集群的标签值。
description.en: The tag value of the dedicated block storage cluster.

description.zh:
专属块存储集群性能类型。取值范围：

- Standard：基础型。该类型的专属块存储集群中可创建ESSD PL0云盘。
- Premium：性能型。该类型的专属块存储集群中可创建ESSD PL1云盘。

默认值：Premium。

关于ESSD云盘的更多信息，请参见[ESSD云盘](~~122389~~)。
description.en:
The performance type of the dedicated block storage cluster. Valid values:

- Standard: basic. You can create PL0 ESSDs in this type of dedicated block storage cluster.
- Premium: performance. You can create PL1 ESSDs in this type of dedicated block storage cluster.

Default value: Premium.

For more information about standard SSDs, see [ESSDs](~~122389~~).

title.en: Create a dedicated block storage cluster

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

- 专属块存储集群（Dedicated Block Storage Cluster）是与其他公共云块存储集群物理隔离、所有者可独享整个集群资源的块存储服务。<props="china">更多信息，请参见[什么是专属块存储集群](~~208883~~)。</props>

- 专属块存储集群上创建的云盘只能挂载到同可用区的ECS实例上。您在创建专属块存储集群前，需要规划好资源所属的地域和可用区。

- 专属块存储集群分为基础型和性能型，您在创建集群时，请根据实际需求选择适用的集群性能类型。

- 创建专属块存储集群需要支付一定的费用。<props="china">更多信息，请参见[计费说明](~~208884~~)。</props>
descriptions.en:
## Operation description

- Dedicated Block Storage Cluster is a block storage service that is physically isolated from other public cloud block storage clusters and provides exclusive access to all cluster resources for the owner.<props="china"> For more information, see [What is Dedicated Block Storage Cluster](~~208883~~).</props>

- Cloud disks created on a dedicated block storage cluster can be attached only to ECS instances in the same zone. Before you create a dedicated block storage cluster, plan the region and zone for the resources.

- Dedicated block storage clusters are classified into basic and performance types. Select the appropriate cluster performance type based on your business requirements when you create a cluster.

- You are charged for creating a dedicated block storage cluster.<props="china"> For more information, see [Billing](~~208884~~).</props>

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs create-dedicated-block-storage-cluster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --azone cn-heyuan-b --dbsc-name myDBSCCluster --capacity 61440 --type Premium --resource-group-id rg-acfmvs0000000 --tag Value=tag-value Key=tag-key --period 12 --period-unit Month --dbsc-id test1233 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ebs CreateDedicatedBlockStorageCluster --region cn-hangzhou --Azone 'cn-heyuan-b' --Tag.1.Key 'tag-key' --Type Premium --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmvs0000000' --Capacity 61440 --Tag.1.Value 'tag-value' --Period 12 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DbscId test1233 --DbscName myDBSCCluster --PeriodUnit Month
